description: This file defines the ResNet50 deep learning model architecture for Keras, including functions for building the model, loading pre-trained weights, and defining residual blocks.

classes.name: identity_block
classes.description: Function implementing the identity residual block used in ResNet50.

classes.name: conv_block
classes.description: Function implementing the convolutional residual block with shortcut in ResNet50.

classes.name: ResNet50
classes.description: Main function to instantiate the ResNet50 architecture, optionally loading pre-trained ImageNet weights.

methods.name: identity_block
methods.description: Builds an identity residual block with no convolution at the shortcut.

methods.name: conv_block
methods.description: Builds a residual block with convolution at the shortcut, used for downsampling.

methods.name: ResNet50
methods.description: Constructs the ResNet50 model architecture with options for top layers, weights, input shape, pooling, and number of classes.
